task:
Refactor: split up `tinydb/utils.py`

`tinydb/utils.py` has turned into a grab bag. Please split it into focused modules:

- Move `LRUCache` (and the private helpers it needs) into a new module `tinydb/cache.py`.
- Move `FrozenDict` and `freeze` into a new module `tinydb/frozen.py`.
- `tinydb/utils.py` keeps only `with_typehint`. Do not leave re-exports, aliases or compatibility imports of the moved names in `tinydb/utils.py`.
- Update every import inside the package to use the new modules.
- Split `tests/test_utils.py` to match: the LRUCache tests go to `tests/test_cache.py` and the freeze/FrozenDict tests go to `tests/test_frozen.py` (delete `tests/test_utils.py` if nothing is left in it).

This is a pure refactor: no behavior changes, and the whole test suite must pass afterwards.
